resolution.note: 6 new enforced task-quality records via krn standards task-quality; red/green fixtures in test/cli/task-quality.test.ts; KRN own tasks zero false-red; init seeds pass

title: Task-quality standards are enforced on tracker tasks and init seeds a passing example task
body:
Why: Fable direction 1115e slice 3. Tracker/task-quality has three records.
Outcome: >=6 enforced task-quality records (measurable acceptance, named proof, named files, one-PR size, declared dependencies, close carries evidence); krn standards check --tasks evaluates them; init seeds an example task that passes.
Files: standards/records.json, src/brain/standards-cli.ts, src/adopt/init.ts.
Proof: red and green fixtures; krn standards check --tasks on KRN's own open tasks has zero false-red. Free.
